name: implement
description: Implement one settled GitHub ticket through TDD, observed verification, committed review, and a pull request.
adaptations: Use connected GitHub feature branches, commits, pull requests, checks, and reviews as Equivalent Mechanisms while protecting the default branch from implicit mutation.
Load tdd only at the upstream testing point and keep both tdd and code-review as separate Dependency Skills rather than embedding their runtimes.

Claim RED, GREEN, typechecks, tests, builds, CI, commits, pushes, reviews, and pull requests only after their live results are observed; stop affected operations when required capability is unavailable.
Quarantine the pinned review-before-commit contradiction as the Temporary Upstream Fix documented in docs/adr/implement-review-order.md.

changeRecords.evidence: The Target Runtime Profile operates on a connected GitHub repository rather than an assumed local checkout. Establishing a non-default feature branch and recording the pre-implementation head preserves the upstream instruction to implement the selected work while providing the immutable fixed point required by the faithful code-review dependency.

transform.match: Implement the work described by the user in the spec or tickets.
transform.replacement: Implement the work described by the user in the spec or tickets. Treat that scope as settled unless a concrete contradiction blocks implementation. Through connected GitHub, resolve the intended base and any existing feature branch or pull request. If the work is not already on an explicitly selected non-default branch, create a feature branch from the intended base before production mutations. Do not mutate the repository default branch unless the upstream workflow and an explicit user instruction authorize that direct mutation; if the required branch or GitHub write capability is unavailable, stop the mutation and report what remains incomplete. Before changing production code, record the current feature-branch head as `review_base` and keep that fixed point unchanged for the later code review.

changeRecords.evidence: The Target Runtime Profile loads Dependency Skills through the MCP load_skill tool. The dependency remains separate and is requested at the same upstream testing point instead of being embedded into implement.

transform.match: Use /tdd where possible, at pre-agreed seams.
transform.replacement: Use `tdd` with `load_skill` where possible, at pre-agreed seams. Request that Dependency Skill at this exact testing point; do not embed its runtime into `implement`. If `tdd` cannot be loaded or the required execution capability is unavailable, stop the affected testing operation and report it as incomplete rather than substituting an unobserved result.

changeRecords.evidence: Remote execution may be provided by connected CI or another live runner rather than a local shell. Preserving the upstream cadence requires observed results before any typecheck or test status is claimed.

transform.match: Run typechecking regularly, single test files regularly, and the full test suite once at the end.
transform.replacement: Run typechecking regularly, single test files regularly, and the full test suite once at the end through whatever live execution mechanism is actually connected. Claim a typecheck, test, build, or CI result only after observing its returned result. If required execution or result inspection is unavailable, stop that verification step and report it as not observed.

changeRecords.evidence: The Target Runtime Profile commits and publishes through connected GitHub. After the quarantined pre-review implementation commit, this final upstream commit step corresponds to justified review-fix commits, final observed verification, and pull-request publication without mutating the default branch implicitly.

transform.match: Commit your work to the current branch.
transform.replacement: After review, commit only justified review fixes to the current feature branch; if no justified fix exists, do not manufacture another commit. Complete the required final observed verification, including the upstream full-suite-at-the-end step when a runner is live, then open or update the pull request from the feature branch to the intended base through connected GitHub. Claim commits, pushes, checks, reviews, pull requests, and their statuses only after observing the corresponding results. If a required write, review, execution, or verification capability is unavailable, stop that affected operation and report exactly what remains incomplete.

transform.match: Once done, use /code-review to review the work.
transform.replacement: Once done, first commit the verified implementation to the current feature branch, then load `code-review` with `load_skill` and review the committed diff from the recorded `review_base` to that implementation commit.
